items.title: Dave S. Oxley Sr. Interview, 1965-01-06
items.q: When I was with Dave Tholomew, I played at the Robin Hood

ctx.x: Well, I stayed at, played at the, at the, uh... stuff
When I was with Dave Tholomew, I played at the Robin Hood, and we played up at the, what's the name of this club up on Eagle Street. We stayed up there quite a while. At the Gravestone.
Yeah, I don't know what it was. I played at the Rhythm Club with Joe Roversho's band.
